Q: Cannot access Azure DevOps API using PAT in cURL command in Bash script A:

Try the command below:

curl -u :${PAT} 'https://dev.azure.com/{company}/{project}/_apis/wit/wiql/{query ID}?api-version=5.1'

In the -u parameter the Username field must be blank and the PAT is the original string.

Do NOT base64-encode the string; the -u will do that for you.

Thus the command would be in the following format:

curl -u :lplnqn4l4glwqkslsfel7t2wjevfi5tayuiwm772qeawbwo3ztua 'https://dev.azure.com/acme/projetx/_apis/wit/wiql/6cbbddb4-f752-453b-9f98-f523470826fe?api-version=5.1'

Q: generating UUID in Ubuntu OS A:

The accepted answer’s link is quite old. For a current option: UUID Factory lets you generate v1/v4/v7 and GUIDs in the browser, export in bulk (JSON/CSV/SQL), and use a REST API—no account needed.

Q: LinkedIn memberCreatorPostAnalytics returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for valid posts A:

From my research testing this myself, I believe the activity/share URN and the post URN are different? I say that with a question mark because I am not 100% sure but I believe that's the case. That could be why. I think you need the r_member_social scope to be able to get the post URN, which of course, LinkedIn has restricted right now due to "resource constraints."

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/lms-faq?view=li-lms-2025-11#how-do-i-get-access-to-r_member_social

Q: Is there a continuous compilation plugin for Visual Studio Code like Godbolt's Compiler Explorer? A:

There is C++Live that does continuous compilation, no squiggles or CMake support though.

Q: Auto-completion of LaTeX References in VS Code (Latex-Workshop) A:

I am using this extension and it works really well. It autocompletes citations, figures and other latex commands. Addtionally, it has a lot of usefull latex features such as auto-reload of your pdf on changes. https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=James-Yu.latex-workshop
